The '''Knights''' [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] were a group of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|racers]] that were adamantly opposed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and lead by [[Finegan Flint]]. The organization was also enemies of the much more destructive [[The Skulls|Skulls]]. They were named for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and attempted to live by a code of honor that separated them from most swoop Gangs. They had more difficulty evading Imperial authorities than the Skulls due to their unwillingness to risk innocent lives.
